title: Criminal Pre-Filing Report

signers.label: District Attorney's Office
signers.note: Reviews the pre-filing and decides whether it proceeds to a Court Docket or is dismissed with prejudice -- filled by the DAO when they process it, not part of intake.

notes: No source Google Doc -- built directly from Bar Procedures Section 4B (Pre-Filings) and Appendix E (Timescales). This is the document that starts a criminal case: it must reach the DAO within 72 hours of arrest or the case is dismissed with prejudice, and the DAO then has 7 days to decide. Keeping intake short on purpose so an officer can file this in the field right after an arrest.

fields.label: Filing Officer
fields.prompt: What is your name? You're the arresting officer (or designated LEO) filing this report.

fields.label: Rank & Department
fields.prompt: What is your rank and department?

fields.label: Defendant
fields.prompt: What is the defendant's full name?

fields.label: Defendant CID
fields.prompt: What is the defendant's CID? Ask them to run /cid in city and share it with you, or answer "Unknown" if you don't have it.

fields.label: Date/Time of Arrest
fields.prompt: What date and time was the defendant arrested? This is important -- it starts the 72-hour clock for getting this pre-filing to the DAO, so please double check it.

fields.label: Date/Time Filed
fields.note: Auto-filled at submission. Compared against arrest_datetime to flag pre-filings approaching or past the 72-hour deadline.

fields.label: Custody Status
fields.prompt: Is the defendant currently being held in custody, or have they been released pending a court date?

fields.label: Bail Hearing Requested
fields.prompt: Are you requesting a bail hearing for the defendant?

fields.label: Charges Sought
fields.prompt: What charges are you seeking against the defendant?

fields.label: Probable Cause / Evidence Summary
fields.prompt: Summarize the evidence and probable cause supporting these charges.

fields.label: Witnesses
fields.prompt: List any witnesses to the incident (or answer "None").

fields.label: Supporting Evidence
fields.prompt: List any supporting evidence attached -- body cam, reports, photos, etc. (or answer "None").

fields.label: DAO Reviewer
fields.note: The DAO official who reviewed this pre-filing. Filled in by the bot when the DAO processes it -- never asked of the filing officer.

fields.label: DAO Decision
fields.note: Selected by the DAO. Per Bar Procedures, if this isn't decided within 7 days of filing, the case is automatically dismissed with prejudice.

fields.label: Docket Number
fields.note: Assigned by the DAO only if dao_decision is 'Filed as Court Docket'.
